programme.title: Marketplace
programme.desc: Canada's consumer watchdog series since 1972, this news program uncovers wrongdoings in the marketplace. With the help of hidden cameras, correspondents dish out the dirt on not so "clean" business practices. Once they get the evidence they need on tape, they apply pressure on businesses to change policies vis-a-vis the products and services they provide to the public.

programme.title: About That
programme.desc: Andrew Chang expands the understanding of the stories everybody's talking about.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby must step into the spiritual world of mediums, psychics, and occult followers to find a killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Milton Cross depend on lord of the manor Edward Milton, for their jobs and income. When Sonia Woodley is found murdered in the churchyard, two years after the death of her abusive husband Gerald, the murder weapon is discovered to be tailor's shears, but which one of villagers is responsible? Barnaby and Jones arrive at Woodley and Woodley, the tailors to find out, to discover that the vicar had received a letter from Sonia a few days before.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a council meeting, Mayor Dave Hicks announces plans to awaken an annual trip to Brighton. Barnaby suspects his proposal to buy coastal land there is a fraud. Barnaby reluctantly joins the party, but during their time in Brighton, hated property developer Hugh Dalgleish is beheaded on a ghost train ride. The detectives together with Tom's cousin DCI John Barnaby gather who from the party or someone else could have been responsible before other murders occur and secrets are uncovered.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Ford Florey is anything but quiet, when the Wild West Society bring their show and fair, consisting of many stalls and a shooting re-enactment. The witch on the 'Dunk the Witch' stall, gets truly dunked and goes horribly wrong, when the water starts turning red. Barnaby and Jones have to be alert with a shooter in their midst. With many grudges, jealousies and a dispute over wasteland, known as 'the swamp', as possible motives, it is not long before more people turn up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: On a dark night in the village of March Magna, Joyce Barnaby swerves her car and narrowly misses a shadowy figure in the road. Shortly after a body is found in the local old cemetery. The victim Gerald Ebbs was a member of the council and of the village's library. It is discovered from the villagers that Gerald had had a strange fixation on both the old hospital and cemetery; in particular a grave from within.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Devington Manor Winter School led by internationally renowned musician Sir Michael Fielding, is a magnet for many aspiring piano students. Amongst the latest batch of students is Zoe Stock, a gifted young lady. Whilst in the grounds of the manor and by the riverbank, Zoe sees a woman jump from the bridge and disappear underwater. When Barnaby and Jones start their enquiries into the possible drowning, they discover many shady connections to the past.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When boxer John Kinsella wins a world title in New York, the village of Midsomer Morchard are overjoyed at his success. Shortly afterwards a solicitor is found dead by his assistant and Kinsella's manager. Barnaby and Jones start to investigate and come across infidelity, anger, betrayals and blackmail. When a Victorian prize-fight re-enactment turns nasty and Kinsella's manager is found murdered in his home's gym.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Midsomer Conservation Society are up in arms, when a recent new build, called Swanscombe House is a highlight of an open garden day. It leads to an ugly confrontation between a couple of its members and those responsible for the planning application, design and build. The people of which are suspected of involvement in a money-making scam. Political squabbles, burglaries and sexual liaisons all come to the fore in picturesque Great Pelfe.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A spa weekend at Swavely Manor, proves far from relaxing, when Tom and Joyce Barnaby arrive. It starts stressful and goes rather downhill when a female client is found dead in the flotation chamber, by Joyce. Barnaby takes a break from his treatment to investigate alongside Jones. The mystery deepens when the woman's husband disappears in the night shortly afterwards. Tom's worries about his future seem to distract him from the case.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: As preparations are underway for Cully Barnaby's wedding, Ned Fitzroy and Beth Porteous are married in Bledlow village. At the gorgeous reception at Bledlow Hall, the maid of honour, Marina Fellowes, is found by a couple of guests murdered in an upstairs room. With the honeymoon postponed, the newlyweds and their guests find themselves being interrogated by the police.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the name of Tommy Hicks, who was executed for cowardice and desertion during World War I, is added to the war memorial in Midsomer Parva, the Hicks family are very glad. The son and grandson, Lionel and Mayor Dave Hicks, revel in the occasion. The Hammond family are much more displeased. Henry, the patriarch, is infuriated by the move, having sustained a long-running feud with the Hickses.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village of Dunstan, leads Barnaby and Jones to investigate the deaths of reclusive couple, Ron and Libby Wilson. Early on in the case, they learn that their son Michael had been killed in a hit and run. Not too far away a fiery dispute is in full swing, between a builder who has a very short fuse and a group of road protesters, protesting about plans for a bypass. With hostilities almost at breaking point, it is not long before another death rocks the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the body of Charlie Finleyson is found in woodland in Midsomer Sonning. Barnaby and Jones begin to scrutinise the employees at the offices of Midsomer Life magazine. It is discovered that Mr Finleyson was married to the ex-wife of Guy Sandys, the wealthy owner of the magazine. The detectives also become aware of a dispute between Guy and the owner of the Morecroft Hotel. With tensions starting to rise between the locals and visitors from London.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a children's magic show, a performer assisting with a trick, is poisoned whilst on stage. It is found that the poison came from a species of Ecuadorean frog. Barnaby and Jones discover that conflict is once again brewing between a village occult guide and enthusiast Ernest Baillol and famous writer Aloysius Wilmington who are both searching for a treasured antique book on the subject.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A team building exercise is imminent planned by a new acting Chief Superintendent John Cotton and Barnaby and Jones are very reluctant to take part. Following an explosion in a truck at a haulage yard, both the detectives see the opportunity as a distraction to investigate. It is not long after that a body is discovered, when a trunk resurfaces from the nearby lake. It is identified as Alec Grainger, a man who had been arguing with James Parkes, the son of Colonel Matt Parkes.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Monks Barton, two couples seemingly disappear from their cottages. When Barnaby and Jones arrive and learn of the legendary, mysterious haunted woods, they remain sceptical. Shortly after a body is found in a shallow grave, answering to the description of one of the 'missing'. The detectives have to delve much deeper into the woods and beyond to find out if ghosts are really to blame or something else.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a canal restoration project near Midsomer Worthy, on which Joyce is working as a volunteer, several skeletons are discovered shortly after a tunnel collapse. DCI Barnaby begins his investigations when it is found that one skeleton had modern dental work. Meanwhile, DS Troy, having been promoted to Inspector has his last case in Midsomer, to look into the murder of a youth, Simon Mayfield (Henry Cavill), who had caused problems for many in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DS Dan Scott, a charming young man but with a bit of an urban chip on his shoulder, arrives in Midsomer as DS Troy's replacement. He is instantly involved in his first case, a woman stabbed after attending a Spanish-themed evening in Midsomer Mallow. Not long after, a retired doctor for whom she had worked is murdered during the village's annual garden open day. It quickly becomes clear that the two victims knew a secret about one of the villagers. Are both crimes connected?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Back in 1970, Roger Heldman died in what appeared to be an accident, during a dig at Midsomer Barrow. It unearthed two important Celtic pieces, a spear and chalice. In present day, Roger's son Gareth is killed with the spear, after having altercations with several villagers. At the climax of the summer solstice celebration Gareth's half brother David Heartley-Reade is killed while performing a ceremony to save his failing marriage.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby and DS Scott arrive in Midsomer St. Michael to investigate the apparently accidental death of former prize-winning author Richard Rackham. But it is discovered that he had had his neck expertly broken before his tumble down the stairs. The village's 12th annual Literary festival brings feuding writers, publishers, and editors to town. When Mr Rackham's editor is then found dead during the festival's opening ceremony, it leads police on a trail of deception, fraud, and hidden truths.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village pub of Midsomer Worthy, The Maid in Splendour, is the workplace of many locals. One night, popular barman Jamie Cruickshank is found dead near an abandoned cottage in the woods. The new manager Stephen Bannerman, who is thoroughly disliked by many, wants to sell the Maid to property developers in secret. When Stephen is murdered, Barnaby and Scott have to find out whether Jamie or Stephen was the intended target of the first murder.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Midsomer Parva have all come out one evening to see the revival of an old Pagan festival. The centrepiece is a straw effigy of a woman. When it is set alight and people look on in wonder, it soon turns to horror when the local curate screams out in pain from within the effigy. The villagers quickly turn against Liz Francis, a local teacher who had organised the event.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Nine years after Ferdy Villiers committed suicide at the family home of Draycott Hall, the extended Villiers family gather together to celebrate Christmas. When a riddle in a Christmas cracker proclaims that two members of the family will be dead by midnight on Boxing Day, everyone takes no notice, until elderly Aunt Lydia nearly dies after getting locked in the garage, after her car has restarted itself and then later in the night, falls down the stairs.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Peter and Caroline Cave are house-hunting in Midsomer Newton, when they hear about a house called Winyard; a tumbledown cottage in the woods. At the estate agents they get informed "that the house is not yet available for viewing". They view the house a short time later by themselves anyway. The following morning they are both found dead in their car, near the house. DCI Barnaby and Acting DC Ben Jones enter a world of property developers, eccentric villagers, estate agents and ghost stories.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Barton, the villagers are all celebrating the annual Oak Apple Week. After the body of a woman is found in a stream, the return of the carnival queen event, after a hiatus of eight years, is speculated to be the reason for a series of murders. With recognisable faces from the past, drunken boasts, hidden obsessions and secret loves, Barnaby and Jones try to restore peace and harmony to the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The wealthy, eccentric and obese Sir Freddy Butler drops dead, shortly after gathering all three of his wives to Haddington Hall to make an announcement. George Bullard tells Barnaby that the death was from natural causes. The case gets more complex when Freddy's solicitor is deliberately killed in an arson attack on his home and Freddy's will goes missing.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Worthy, council clerk Martin Barrett is shot to death through his kitchen window, while a mystery woman settles in, in the spare room upstairs. Barnaby and Jones discover Barrett was a skillful blackmailer, and believe his murderer to be one of his victims. The investigation takes Barnaby and Joyce to the seaside at Fennacombe Bay and Jones to question Sir John Waverley.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A 90-year-old feud between the male and female inhabitants of Broughton once again comes to a head with an event known as the Skimmington Ride. When elderly Ms Danvers is poisoned a short time before the event takes place. Barnaby and Jones have to investigate whether it was to do with the feud, a long held buried secret, or something else. This looks more likely when the Rev. Anthony Gant is shot and killed whilst taking part in the traditional ride. Before another villager ends up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Villagers of Eleverton-cum-Latterly are divided over the building of a new supermarket development. When Barnaby and Jones investigate they find he came to the village for secret rendezvous with various female villagers in fantasy role-playing scenarios.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night: Give Me Your Life
programme.desc: Gillespie, Forbes and the Sparta police investigate allegations of child abuse in a mysterious religious cult.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night: A Matter Of Justice
programme.desc: A serial killer is on the loose in Sparta, and all the clues lead straight to a wealthy, retired judge.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
programme.desc: When an actress arrives in Sparta, Gillespie is one of the few who know of her secret connection to the town.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night: By Duty Bound
programme.desc: With Gillespie's term as Sheriff coming to an end, it becomes a case of political intrigue and murder.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night: Grow Old Along With Me
programme.desc: Gillespie and Forbes get involved in the case of an alcohol-infused driver in this made for TV movie.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: When Virgil Tibbs joins the Sparta, MI, police, resentment festers in Chief of Police Bill Gillespie.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Gillespie and Tibbs are at odds when Tibbs suspects that Gillespie's old friend, Sonny Mims, killed his wife.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Emotions run high when a black businessman (Randy Brooks) comes to Sparta to buy the town's newspaper.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Sparta is overjoyed when a local boy turned successful businessman offers to bring his business back home.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Virgil (Howard Rollins) narrowly escapes death at the hands of Ritchie Epson's henchmen.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: When a wealthy bigamist (Ted Lange) turns up dead in his cell, which of his wives turns out to be a murderer?

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: An escaped convict and his girlfriend leave a trail of bodies in their wake as they travel through Mississippi

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Twenty years after a young woman is gruesomely murdered, a similar crime is committed.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A respected citizen and prominent businessman of Sparta (Wallace Wilkinson) is mysteriously murdered.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: An unexpected visit from Virgil's best friend happens to coincide with the murder of two agents and a witness.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Chief Bill Gillespie discovers that a longtime friend and sheriff of neighboring Butler County is a racist.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Bubba Skinner is seduced by a beautiful lady who has taken residence in Sparta in order to write a novel.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Virgil believes he acted in self-defense when he shoots a robbery suspect, but begins to doubt his own actions

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Virgil Tibbs’s niece and Bubba Skinner's nephew find common ground -- and trouble -- in Sparta.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Gillespie suspects a newly arrived cook in town may be involved in the recent murder of a young prostitute.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Virgil and his wife attend services at an all-white church. The reverend collapses, dead at the pulpit.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) is informed that a death row prisoner wants him present at his execution.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Three convicts escape from prison, and one of them is out for revenge against the women who sent him to prison

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A tiny newborn infant is found dead in the Sparta city dump, and more than just the teenage mother is suspect.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Detective Virgil Tibbs investigates a series of elderly citizens that are being beaten and robbed.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Tibbs and Sweet investigate a woman who has been beaten and left for dead on the banks of a local creek.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Virgil Tibbs and Chief Bill Gillespie investigate a murder of a father of two very different daughters.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Virgil and Gillespie are faced with a violent labor strike at the local Sparta river plant.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Tensions run high in the police department and in Sparta when Bubba is accused of attacking a black woman.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Sparta is shocked by a deadly hit-and-run accident after a regional basketball tournament.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: While Chief Bill Gillespie is out of town, a series of mysterious fires break out in town.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: When a human leg bone is discovered, Sparta police question an eccentric old lady named known as the Pig Lady.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: When Tibbs investigates Gillespie's kidnapping, all the signs seem to point to a racially motivated crime.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: When Althea is raped by a fellow teacher, Virgil desperately wants revenge and is forced to a breaking point.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: When a young beauty queen contestant commits suicide, Gillespie and Virgil make a startling discovery.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A woman murders her wealthy, abusive husband with the help of her lover.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: When the first Black female officer on the Sparta police force is killed, Gillespie sets out to get justice.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Gillespie and Tibbs are desperate to halt the spread of crack cocaine among the young people of their town.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Gillespie is let go after being abducted by white supremacists right before the visit of a civil rights leader

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Officer Parker Williams must face his feelings when his neighbor is accused of killing a private investigator.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Two men are determined to avenge their brother's death after he is killed by Lieutenant Skinner.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: While hitchhiking his way to Sparta, a Vietnamese teenager witnesses a store robbery that turns into a murder.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: An ex-prizefighter tries to blackmail his old boss, a mafia kingpin in Detroit.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A close friend of Chief Gillespie's is devastated over the death of his wife and angrily blames her doctor.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A mild-mannered Sparta businessman shoots his wife and her lover and then flees with his daughter.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: A friend of Bubba's is framed for theft and kills himself. Only his young son knows the truth.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: An elderly resident of a nursing home informs Chief Gillespie that a murder has taken place at the home.
